name: structured-certificate-validation-domain-v1.4
description: Curated deterministic structured certificate validation prompts for rating, bonding, SPD typing, and measurement-derived review workflows. Threshold-driven checks rely on pipeline-derived categorical flags so the rule engine remains operator-compatible.

rules.message: The recorded main switch rating does not match the recorded incomer rating, so the supply arrangement or data entry should be reviewed.
rules.summaryComment: Main switch rating conflicts with the recorded incomer rating.

reportTargets.reason: Main switch rating should be reviewed alongside the incomer rating.
Incomer rating should be reviewed alongside the main switch rating.

observation.title: Main switch and incomer ratings should be checked together
observation.comment: Structured certificate data records different ratings for the main switch and incomer.

rules.message: An SPD type is recorded but the certificate does not indicate SPD presence, so surge protection details should be reviewed.
rules.summaryComment: Recorded SPD type conflicts with SPD presence being marked absent.

reportTargets.reason: SPD presence should normally align with a recorded SPD type.
SPD type should be checked against the recorded presence.

observation.title: SPD presence and SPD type should be aligned
observation.comment: Structured certificate data records an SPD type while SPD presence is marked absent.

rules.message: The certificate indicates SPD is present but no recognised SPD type is recorded, so the surge protection entry should be checked.
rules.summaryComment: SPD is marked present without a recognised SPD type entry.

reportTargets.reason: SPD presence should be reviewed with the SPD type entry.
SPD type should be recorded when SPD is marked present.

observation.title: SPD type should be recorded when SPD is present
observation.comment: Structured certificate data indicates SPD presence without a recognised SPD type value.

rules.message: Structured certificate data indicates gas bonding is not present, so main protective bonding to gas should be reviewed in context.
rules.summaryComment: Gas bonding is marked absent in the structured certificate data.

reportTargets.reason: Gas bonding entry should be reviewed against site conditions and certificate notes.
If bonding exists, the conductor size should also be confirmed.

observation.title: Gas bonding provision should be reviewed
observation.comment: Structured certificate data marks gas bonding as not present.

rules.message: Structured certificate data indicates water bonding is not present, so main protective bonding to water should be reviewed in context.
rules.summaryComment: Water bonding is marked absent in the structured certificate data.

reportTargets.reason: Water bonding entry should be reviewed against site conditions and certificate notes.
If bonding exists, the conductor size should also be confirmed.

observation.title: Water bonding provision should be reviewed
observation.comment: Structured certificate data marks water bonding as not present.

rules.message: No main protective bonding to extraneous-conductive-parts is recorded, so bonding-specific inspection schedule items should be marked not applicable.
rules.summaryComment: Main protective bonding items have been marked not applicable because no bonded extraneous-conductive-parts are recorded.

reportTargets.reason: Gas bonding is recorded absent.
Water bonding is recorded absent.
Oil bonding is recorded absent.
Structural steel bonding is recorded absent.
Bonding labels for extraneous-conductive-parts are not applicable where no such bonding is present.
Main protective bonding conductor size confirmation is not applicable where no bonding conductors are present.
Main protective bonding conductor connection checks are not applicable where no bonding conductors are present.

observation.title: Main protective bonding inspection items not applicable
observation.comment: No main protective bonding to extraneous-conductive-parts is recorded, so inspection items 3.3, 3.6 and 3.7 should be marked N/A.

scheduleItems.comment: No main protective bonding to extraneous-conductive-parts is recorded.
No main protective bonding to extraneous-conductive-parts is recorded.
No main protective bonding to extraneous-conductive-parts is recorded.

rules.message: Earth electrode details are recorded even though the earthing arrangement is not TT or IT, so the electrode entries should be reviewed and blanked if not applicable.
rules.summaryComment: Earth electrode details are populated for a non-TT/non-IT arrangement and should be reviewed for applicability.

reportTargets.reason: Earthing arrangement determines whether installation earth electrode details are applicable.
Earth electrode details should normally be blank where the earthing arrangement is not TT or IT.

observation.title: Earth electrode details may be not applicable
observation.comment: Structured certificate data records earth electrode details even though the earthing arrangement is not TT or IT.

rules.message: Earth electrode details are recorded while the means of earthing is marked as distributor's facility, so the electrode entries should be reviewed and blanked if not applicable.
rules.summaryComment: Earth electrode details conflict with means of earthing being recorded as distributor's facility.

reportTargets.reason: Means of earthing should align with whether installation earth electrode details are applicable.
Earth electrode details should normally be blank when distributor's facility is recorded as the means of earthing.

observation.title: Earth electrode details conflict with means of earthing
observation.comment: Structured certificate data records earth electrode details while means of earthing is marked as distributor's facility.

rules.message: The earthing arrangement is recorded as TT, so installation earth electrode details should be applicable and the missing entries should be reviewed.
rules.summaryComment: TT earthing arrangement is recorded without complete installation earth electrode details.

reportTargets.reason: TT arrangements normally require installation earth electrode details to be recorded.
Earth electrode type should be recorded where TT earthing applies.
Earth electrode location should be recorded where TT earthing applies.
Earth electrode resistance should be recorded where TT earthing applies.

observation.title: TT earthing should include earth electrode details
observation.comment: Structured certificate data marks the earthing arrangement as TT without complete earth electrode entries.

rules.message: The means of earthing is recorded as installation earth electrode, so the earth electrode details should be applicable and missing entries should be reviewed.
rules.summaryComment: Means of earthing indicates installation earth electrode without complete electrode details.

reportTargets.reason: Installation earth electrode selection means electrode details should normally be completed.
Earth electrode type should be recorded when installation earth electrode is selected.
Earth electrode location should be recorded when installation earth electrode is selected.
Earth electrode resistance should be recorded when installation earth electrode is selected.

observation.title: Installation earth electrode selection should include details
